items.title: TD Cowen Raises Its Walmart Target to $147. Is It Still Too Low?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysTD Cowen raised its Walmart price target to $147 from $125 and kept its Buy rating after a beat-and-raise quarter. The firm expects fast e-commerce growth to lift margins, and at least eight other firms raised targets the same day.

items.title: Target (TGT) Stock Fair Value Edges Higher After Q3 Analyst Target Increases
items.summary: Target’s updated fair value estimate has shifted from US$164.68 to US$172.34, which points to a slightly higher implied price target in the latest model. Analysts link this change to Q3 results that highlighted traffic led comparable sales, margin outperformance versus expectations, and raised FY26 guidance, along with a reset higher across many published price targets into the mid to high US$170s and in some cases up to US$205. As you read on, you will see how this evolving Target narrative...
